source: Converted from the RTA GTFS open feed (rta_gtfs-open, Dubai Pulse; the copy Transitland mirrors as f-dubai~rta) by packages/content-tools/src/publishTransport.ts. Stops, routes and stop sequences from the feed; rail platforms collapsed into stations and named from data/transport/stations.v1.json; bus stops keep the RTA English name. Durations are the median over the feed; first/last departures and headways are for a typical weekday (the feed's Monday services). Fares are Nol bands and a meter estimate, not from the feed. Nothing here is fetched at runtime and no tiles are downloaded (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
attribution: Transport data: Roads and Transport Authority (RTA), Dubai — open data.
